Method of Attack: Spam campaign with malicious document attachments containing macros that install malware
Steals emails and uses infected computers to send further spam
Installs other malware leading to ransomware attacks
Impacted Systems: Windows computers (implied by Microsoft Word documents and macros)
Attack Vector: Email spam with malicious Word document attachments
Indicators of Compromise: Email subjects: 'Team Blue Take Action', 'Valanters 2020', 'List of works', 'Volunteer'
Malicious document filenames: 'Team Blue Take Action.doc', 'List of works.doc', 'Valanters 2020.doc', 'Volunteer.doc'
Attachments prompting to 'Enable Content' to activate macros
